name: claco
headline: claco CLI tool for Claude Code productivity
short_description: claco is a CLI tool that boosts Claude Code productivity by managing custom agents, slash commands, hooks, and project session history.
author: kaichen

sections.overview:
claco is a command-line helper designed to enhance Claude Code workflow efficiency. It provides centralized management for custom agents, slash commands, and hooks configuration, while also offering detailed visibility into project history and session information. The tool enables developers to import agents and commands from GitHub repositories or local files, generate new configurations with templates, and inspect all user messages within a project or specific session. claco supports multiple installation methods including Homebrew, npm, and Cargo, making it accessible across different development environments.
Import and manage custom AI agents from GitHub repositories
Configure and list Claude Code slash commands for project-specific workflows
Set up event-based hooks like sound notifications for Claude Code events
Export and audit all user messages from a project session
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/kaichen/claco`
sections.usage:
```
I'm using claco to manage my Claude Code workflow. Here's what I need: [SPECIFIC_TASK]. I'm working with [PROGRAMMING_LANGUAGE] and my project involves [PROJECT_TYPE]. Can you help me set up the right claco commands?
```
